character: A large south-central Vermont resort above the town of Ludlow, operated by Vail Resorts, with two main base areas (the original base and Jackson Gore) and a reputation for groomed, family-friendly skiing.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base areas. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79/I-88 to Albany, NY-7 E to Bennington, US-7 N to Manchester, then VT-11 E and VT-100 N to Ludlow); not a routing-service result. VT-11 over the Green Mountains can be slow in winter.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-7 E to Bennington, US-7 N to Manchester, VT-11/VT-100 to Ludlow); not a routing-service result.
